body.purpose: Readable application text and controls across Android and browsers.

shadows.name: bottom-navigation
shadows.purpose: Separate persistent bottom navigation from scrolling content.

shadows.name: floating-action
shadows.purpose: Keep the floating primary action distinct from the page surface.

motion.name: control-state
motion.purpose: Subtle color and border transitions for interactive controls.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary action with the user's current palette accent.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { min-height: 48px; padding: 12px 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--ion-color-primary); color: var(--ion-color-primary-contrast); font-family: inherit; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--ion-color-primary); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Surface Panel
components.description: Flat container for a related set of budget details.
components.html:
Monthly overview

Income and obligations
components.css: .ds-panel { padding: 14px; border: 1px solid var(--plan-rule); border-radius: 10px; background: var(--plan-surface); color: var(--plan-ink); } .ds-panel h2 { margin: 0 0 8px; font-family: inherit; font-size: 1.1rem; font-weight: 600; } .ds-panel p { margin: 0; color: var(--plan-muted); }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Labeled field on a semantic surface, with an accent focus state.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; color: var(--plan-ink); font-family: inherit; font-size: 0.9rem; font-weight: 500; } .ds-field input { width: 100%; min-height: 48px; padding: 12px 14px; border: 1px solid var(--plan-rule); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--plan-surface); color: var(--plan-ink); font-family: inherit; font-size: 1rem; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--ion-color-primary); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Selected Filter Chip
components.description: Compact selected state for a month or filter choice.
components.css: .ds-chip { min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--plan-rule); border-radius: 7px; background: var(--plan-surface-muted); color: var(--plan-ink); font-family: inherit; font-size: 0.9rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--ion-color-primary); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Compact Navigation
components.description: Labeled bottom destinations for compact screens.
components.html: HomeExpensesReportsDebts
components.css: .ds-nav { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 4px; padding: 8px; border-top: 1px solid var(--plan-rule); background: var(--plan-surface); } .ds-nav a { display: grid; min-height: 48px; place-items: center; border-radius: 8px; color: var(--plan-muted); font-family: inherit; font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav a[aria-current='page'] { background: var(--plan-surface-muted); color: var(--plan-accent-ink); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--ion-color-primary); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: Salapi presents household finances as calm, legible planning pages. Paper-like canvases, fine rules, and aligned amounts make income, spending, and obligations easy to compare. Each selected palette has coordinated light and dark surfaces and accents. A compact bottom navigation bar becomes a persistent rail on wide screens.
keyCharacteristics: Information-first layouts with tabular financial amounts.
Flat, ruled surfaces and a restrained accent palette.

rules.name: Accent Follows Preference
rules.body: Primary actions and selected states follow the palette and light/dark settings chosen by the user.

rules.name: Rule-First Panels
rules.body: Use surface contrast and fine borders before elevation; reserve shadows for persistent or floating controls.

rules.name: Planning-Grid Totals
rules.body: Reserve the low-contrast 28px grid for the balance hero and financial snapshots.

rules.name: Adaptive Shell
rules.body: Keep destinations consistent while adapting bottom tabs into a left rail on wide screens.

dos: Use semantic plan tokens for surfaces, text, rules, and status.
Keep touch-sized controls and visible keyboard focus.
donts: Do not hard-code a single accent color into shared components.
Do not use elevation or the planning grid as default decoration.
